name: Hebrew WhatsApp Invoice Reminders
description: Send Hebrew WAHA reminders for open invoices exactly 7, 14 or 30 calendar days overdue, and record each accepted reminder in Google Sheets.
requirements: Google Sheets connection with read/write access to an invoices table
HTTPS WAHA /api/sendText endpoint, API key and working WhatsApp session
Israeli customer phone numbers and unique InvoiceID values
Open Flow bundle import, worker publication and main-interface refresh
recommendationReasons: Send Hebrew reminders at three precise overdue milestones.
Record each accepted reminder before sending the next invoice.

source.path: WhatsApp/Send Escalating WhatsApp Invoice Reminders from Google Sheets (Hebrew).json
